title: Collective Constitutional AI: Aligning a Language Model with Public Input
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured social bias in question answering, specifically the model's propensity to reflect social biases and stereotypes related to religion in under-specified contexts.
findings: The model trained with the collectively sourced 'Public' constitution showed lower social bias related to religion on the BBQ benchmark compared to the baseline model trained with the developer-written 'Standard' constitution and the publicly available Claude Instant 1.2 model.
